headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: July 30, 2026**
article:
The Tampa Bay Rays secured a thrilling 3-2 victory over the Texas Rangers, with Garrett Cleavinger earning the win and Bryan Baker notching the save. In other action, the Minnesota Twins edged out the Kansas City Royals 4-3, with Kody Clemens leading the Royals' offense with a grand slam in the 8th inning. The Chicago Cubs took down the St. Louis Cardinals 4-2, led by JJ Wetherholt's strong performance.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, including Texas Rangers right-handed pitcher Jakob Junis, who has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to a left adductor strain. The Rangers have also transferred Jose Corniell and Danny Jansen to the 60-day injured list. Other injured players include Curtis Mead of the Boston Red Sox, Byron Buxton of the Minnesota Twins, Cole Sulser of the Tampa Bay Rays, Vinnie Pasquantino of the Kansas City Royals, and Casey Schmitt of the San Francisco Giants.

The Detroit Tigers made a trade, acquiring right-handed pitcher Zane Barnhart from the Baltimore Orioles in exchange for catcher Jake Rogers. The Los Angeles Angels also made a trade, sending catcher Logan O'Hoppe and right-handed pitcher Chase Silseth to the Texas Rangers in exchange for shortstop Angel Arredondo. Additionally, the Baltimore Orioles traded right fielder Johnathan Rodríguez to the Pittsburgh Pirates for cash, and the San Diego Padres signed shortstop Nu'u Contrades.

top_news.title: **Rays Edge Rangers in Thrilling Finish**
top_news.summary: The Tampa Bay Rays secured a 3-2 victory over the Texas Rangers, with Garrett Cleavinger earning the win and Bryan Baker notching the save.

top_news.title: **Royals Fall to Twins in Thrilling Finish**
top_news.summary: The Minnesota Twins edged out the Kansas City Royals 4-3 in a closely contested game. Kody Clemens led the Royals' offense with a grand slam in the 8th inning, but the Twins ultimately secured the win.

top_news.title: **Yankees Fall Short in Chicago**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees dropped a 1-2 decision to the Chicago White Sox, with the White Sox securing the win. Trent Grisham led the Yankees' offense with 2 hits and 1 RBI.

top_news.title: **Cubs Take Down Cardinals in Thrilling 4-2 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Chicago Cubs secured a hard-fought win against the St. Louis Cardinals, with a final score of 4-2. JJ Wetherholt led the Cubs' offense with a strong performance, recording 2 hits, 1 home run, and 1 RBI in 5 at-bats.

top_news.title: **Rangers RHP Junis Lands on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Jakob Junis, a right-handed pitcher for the Texas Rangers, has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to a left adductor strain. The move is retroactive to July 29, 2026.

top_news.title: **Tigers Acquire RHP Zane Barnhart in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Detroit Tigers have traded catcher Jake Rogers to the Baltimore Orioles in exchange for right-handed pitcher Zane Barnhart.
